evidence: Labeled Validation; modifies ConnectTip in src/validation.cpp and introduces asynchronous block read-ahead for chainstate connection.
rationale: Prefetching and deserializing blocks asynchronously yields substantial, measurable speedups for IBD and reindexing. Author benchmarks show reindex-chainstate speedups of 1.53x on HDD (30,017 s to 19,609 s) and 1.30x on SSD (12,430 s to 9,562 s), with independent review confirmation of major speedups.
